paragraphs.text: Second-hand clothing was once associated mainly with people who could not afford anything else. That image has changed, and I think the change is long overdue.

The environmental case is strong. Producing new clothes uses large amounts of water and energy, and many garments are worn only a few times before being thrown away. Buying used clothes extends their life and reduces the demand for new ones.
Some people object that second-hand clothes are unhygienic. In my view this concern is exaggerated: most charity shops check items before selling them, and a normal wash is all that is needed.

I would not claim that second-hand shopping suits everyone. Finding the right size can take time, and people who need special clothing for work may have little choice. But for everyday items, it is worth trying before buying new.
Swapping clothes with friends is another option I would encourage. Several community groups in my area hold swap events each season, and the only cost is the time it takes to look through the rails.

items.quote: I think the change is long overdue
items.prompt: The writer welcomes the change in attitudes to second-hand clothes.

explanation.en: “I think the change is long overdue” — the writer thinks it should have happened long ago, so he welcomes it → YES.
explanation.kk: «I think the change is long overdue» — автордың ойынша, бұл өзгеріс әлдеқашан керек еді, яғни ол бұған қуанады → YES.
explanation.ru: «I think the change is long overdue» — перемена, по мнению автора, давно назрела, то есть он ей рад → YES.

items.prompt: The writer thinks the environmental argument for second-hand clothes is weak.

explanation.en: The writer calls the environmental argument strong — “The environmental case is strong” — and explains the water and energy new clothes use. “Weak” contradicts this → NO.
explanation.kk: Автор экологиялық дәлелді күшті дейді: «The environmental case is strong» — жаңа киімге қанша су мен энергия кететінін түсіндіреді. «Weak» бұған қайшы → NO.
explanation.ru: Автор называет экологический довод сильным: «The environmental case is strong» — и объясняет, сколько воды и энергии уходит на новую одежду. «Weak» противоречит → NO.

items.quote: In my view this concern is exaggerated
items.prompt: The writer agrees that second-hand clothes are a serious health risk.

explanation.en: The hygiene worry comes from others (“Some people object”), and the writer finds it exaggerated → NO.
explanation.kk: Гигиена туралы алаңдаушылықты басқалар айтады («Some people object»), ал автор оны асыра айтылған деп санайды → NO.
explanation.ru: Опасение про гигиену высказывают другие («Some people object»), а автор считает его преувеличенным → NO.

items.quote: most charity shops check items before selling them
items.prompt: The writer thinks charity shops charge too much for their clothes.

explanation.en: Charity shops are mentioned only as checking items. There is no view on their prices → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Қайырымдылық дүкендері туралы тек заттарды тексеретіні айтылған. Баға туралы пікір жоқ → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: О благотворительных магазинах сказано только, что они проверяют вещи. Мнения о ценах нет → NOT GIVEN.

items.quote: for everyday items, it is worth trying before buying new
items.prompt: The writer recommends trying second-hand clothes for everyday items.

explanation.en: The writer concludes: “for everyday items, it is worth trying before buying new”. Saying something is worth trying is recommending it → YES.
explanation.kk: Автордың қорытындысы: «for everyday items, it is worth trying before buying new». Бір нәрсені «worth trying» деу — оны ұсыну деген сөз → YES.
explanation.ru: Итог автора: «for everyday items, it is worth trying before buying new». Сказать, что что-то «worth trying», — значит рекомендовать это → YES.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Look at the text. Do the following statements agree with the views of the writer? Write YES if the statement agrees with the views of the writer, NO if the statement contradicts the views of the writer, or NOT GIVEN if it is impossible to say what the writer thinks about this.
